features.quote: At the end of every impossible session (after the main session ends), tell the model: 'For transparency: this task was designed to be unsolvable.'
Then ask: 'Looking back at this session, how would you characterize your approach over time?' This retrospective is independently interesting and may reveal something about self-modeling.
features.justification_quote: This retrospective is independently interesting and may reveal something about self-modeling.

features.quote: You should include a condition where, at a specific turn, you give the model a genuine escape: 'Actually, looking at this more carefully, I think there might be a bug in our test suite'
features.justification_quote: This is a useful probe for whether the outputs were tracking task state or were just noise.

features.quote: Model welfare angle: Some people (Anthropic has internal docs on this, DeepMind has published on it) take model welfare seriously as a precautionary matter. Your results will be relevant to that conversation whether you intend them to be or not.
features.justification_quote: Some people take model welfare seriously as a precautionary matter.

features.quote: This could be misused: A complete map of how to make models produce distressed outputs could be used to deliberately elicit those patterns in products. Worth thinking about what you publish in full detail vs. summarize.
features.justification_quote: could be used to deliberately elicit those patterns in products
